description:
`command_group!` has one entry form per storage shape folded into a single entry rule, and groups share one count-message helper, so the macro has fewer near-identical arms.

## Background

`command_group!` in `crates/jit/src/dispatch/mod.rs` has grown separate entry arms for its storage shapes (concrete store, generic bound and executor-free), which differ only in how the handler context is built. Several groups (item, events, label, doc) each keep a helper that formats a "N item(s)" message for a list outcome.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `command_group!` has one entry arm for the storage shapes, with the context construction selected by an internal rule, and every group compiles against it unchanged apart from its declaration.
- [hard] REQ-02: List outcomes take their count message from one shared helper, and no group keeps its own.
- [hard] REQ-03: No command's JSON payload, human output, schema or exit code changes, and the handler-form tests pass unweakened.
- [hard] REQ-04: The change removes at least 10 production lines from `crates/jit/src` (default mode of `scripts/production-lines.py`).

## Notes

Lands with or after the main.rs reduction that removes the transitional pass-through form, so the macro is edited once. Part of the epic's net-reduction work (plan D-51).
title: One entry rule for every command_group! storage shape
